statement_summary: Qualified Individual designated; Finance retains responsibility and oversees
Holding company protects Finance customer information under the intercompany agreement
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment and after major changes
Risk acceptance authority by level; subsidiaries may not accept shared-platform risk
Security sanctions
Security review and contract terms before supplier access; annual review of critical suppliers
Board report twice a year; Qualified Individual written report annually
Unique accounts; no shared accounts
Least privilege; cross-subsidiary and Finance data need owner approval
MFA for everyone; hardware keys for admins and high-risk roles
At most 2 standing global admins; break-glass accounts
Same-day access removal at termination
Identity verification before MFA reset; MSP may not reset MFA
One group incident plan; no separate subsidiary processes
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Meet notification deadlines including FTC 30 days
Annual tabletop with subsidiaries and the MSP
Encrypt Restricted data; group-managed key for bank files
Restricted label blocks all-employee sharing and AI retrieval
Retention schedule; 90-day ACH deletion; two-year disposal rule
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly; independent suite backup
Annual training; monthly reminders; quarterly phishing simulations; fraud training
Callback and second approver for any bank-detail change
Approved AI tools only; no AI in employment or credit decisions
